text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Spike in 502/504s observed at apigw-eu-west. Error rate ~11% over last 5m, customer-visible. Paging oncall.

sam: Ack. I'm on it, joining now.

devon: I see the dashboards — backend upstream latency creeping, 95th ~2.3s, retries spiking. Any recent deploys to apigw or routing changes?

leila: No deploys in apigw in last 30m. We did push a routing config to mux-edge ~40m ago (rollout 10%). Could be related.

ops-shift: Confirmed symptoms from synthetic checks: health checks returning 200 but proxying requests intermittently 502/504. Tracing shows timeouts between apigw and model-pool-3.

sam: OK. Quick mitigation checklist: 1) Pause mux-edge rollout 2) Enable fallback routing to apigw-secondary 3) Increase upstream timeout to 10s 4) If still bad, circuit-break gateway -> degrade non-critical routes.

emily: Doing (1) and (2) now. Patch: `kubectl patch rollout mux-edge --pause` and flipped route weight to apigw-secondary=80%.

devon: Running curl against model-pool-3 from apigw host: ```curl -v http://model-pool-3.internal/predict -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 6``` Seeing `upstream read timeout` intermittently.

leila: Looking at model-pool-3 nodes — CPU OK but time_waits are high, connections piling. Could be head-of-line due to an unhealthy replica.

ops-shift: Scaling model-pool-3 +2 replicas now: `redwoodctl scale pool model-pool-3 6`

sam: While that scales, increase apigw upstream timeout on the edge proxy to 10s: `edgectl set conf apigw upstream_timeout=10s --apply` (apply only to eu-west).

emily: Timeout bumped and rollout paused. Also temporarily reduced keepalive to 30s on proxy.

devon: I see a suspicious 503 pattern from one replica (model-pool-3-2). Logs show `worker crash: oom-kill` around 1748007200. That node might be flapping and exhausting connection pool.

leila: Marking model-pool-3-2 as drained: `redwoodctl drain node model-pool-3-2`. Starting replacement.

product-sd: Quick customer-impact note: Top 5 customers seeing increased error rate on production endpoints: acct-123, acct-88, acct-77. CS alerted. ETA for mitigation?

sam: Baseline mitigation applied (route fallback + scale + drain). Monitoring error rate now.

incident-bot: Metrics update: error rate dropped to 4.2% after route shift + scale (2m). Latency 95th reduced to 1.1s.

devon: Good signal. Keep the rollout paused and node replaced. Follow-up: add a connection pool backoff on apigw to avoid hammering flapping replicas. I'll open a follow-up PR.

emily: Noted. Rolling node replacement complete. Model-pool-3 back to healthy replicas=6.

leila: Running postmortem checklist: collect heap/dumps from crashed instance, check autoscaling thresholds, evaluate whether OOM caused by recent model config change.

sam: I'll own incident and post an incident summary once we verify root cause. For now, keeping routing fallback until next deployment window.

product-sd: I'll keep CS updated and draft a short customer message (no PII).

ops-shift: Leaving ops watch on this for 2 hours. Reverting keepalive to default after stability window.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Duration so far: ~14m.

sam: Thanks team. Good triage. End of active command-room for now. :thumbsup:
